dialogueTranscript.text: Bovar (Comms) Adoptive Father 1 / 3 Kai, Jax—stay off the main avenue! The Fang Syndicate locked down the Alley Gate and swept half the block. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 3 Let them try to hold the street. Give the word, Kai, and I'll break their frontline wide open. Skip Scene Next
Kai Memory-Web Heir 3 / 3 Stay sharp. Civilians are still trapped past the market stalls, and something near the plaza is tearing at my head—like a static echo. Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 2 That's the first squad down. Keep moving—two neighbors are pinned behind the shipping crates and up on the fire-escape deck. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 2 I see the overhead crane line. Swing across or vault the crates—I'm right on your flank. Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 2 Look at the pavement—threads of violet light bleeding out of the stone. Someone tried to scrub what happened here. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 2 My mane's bristling just standing near it. Pull it together, brother—let's see what the Syndicate is hiding. Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 2 That memory echo... Boryn stood at this gate before the city fell silent. The Fang Syndicate didn't take Ashblock alone. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 2 Answers are on the other side of that Alley Gate. Let's tear the lock off. Skip Scene Continue
Fang Enforcer Syndicate Heavy Commander 1 / 3 Two stray cubs rattling the gate? Bovar should've kept you chained indoors. Ashblock belongs to the Fang now. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 3 Big talk for a tin-plated bully. Watch his hammer swing—it's heavy, which means it leaves an opening! Skip Scene Next
Kai Memory-Web Heir 3 / 3 Together, Jax. Don't let him corner us! Skip Scene Continue
Fang Enforcer Syndicate Heavy Commander 1 / 4 Enough games! Hydraulic Overdrive—let's crush this courtyard down to bedrock! Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 4 Kai—his shockwave's locking down the whole plaza! My storm and your threads are resonating! Skip Scene Next
Kai Memory-Web Heir 3 / 4 Ember, Storm, and Memory... three threads, one will. Grab on, brother—NOW! Skip Scene Next
Kai-Jax The Memory Hero (Three-Tail Convergence) 4 / 4 We remember what you tried to erase. Press Fusion [F] to unleash Kai-Jax and finish the Enforcer! Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 3 The Enforcer's down, and the blockade across Ashblock Heights is breaking. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 3 That felt like thunder and fire forged into one body. Whatever Borax and Boryn hid from us... it's waking up. Skip Scene Next
Bovar (Comms) Adoptive Father 3 / 3 I felt that surge from three blocks away. Catch your breath, boys—Sector-7 scouts already know the gate fell. Rest at Ashblock and prepare. Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 2 The Architect Scout's relay is offline. Their telemetry was feeding straight into Neon Ward. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 2 Then Neon Ward is our next stop—or we can regroup back at Ashblock Heights anytime. Skip Scene Continue
Kai Memory-Web Heir 1 / 2 Another district ward is broken—the memory threads across Raging City are reconnecting. Skip Scene Next
Jax Storm Fang 2 / 2 Our lineage is waking up across every sector. Let's check the Raging City map for our next target. Skip Scene Continue

Borax The Law · Elder Mentor 2 / 2 You carried the city across eight districts and forged your own path. Raging City is finally free. Skip Scene Continue
